title: Eight French and Spanish readings integrated across energy, finance, human futures and mobility
summary: Eight complete readings bring the local inventory to 26 of 34 translations across thirteen topics. AI fidelity review and integration occurred November 21. The readings retain September 10 English authorship and the September 1 evidence cutoff; eight translation contracts remain unfinished.
evidence_note: All eighteen prior integrated records, original edition contracts and 58 annual AI decisions are preserved. The annual accessibility appendix still binds its retained ten-translation input. Original preparation notices are retained as historical notes, separate from the current integration dateline. Saved exact-source context is shown with its actual inspection dates. Human Futures also exposes the three saved Toronto 24 254930 project checks, including the September 28 access blocker; the general Toronto pipeline citation in Finance and Risk does not inherit that named-project decision. No external source inspection or new cycle receipt was performed for this integration.
publication_effect: Local content and provenance integration only. AI linguistic review is not independent human review, accessibility certification, fresh evidence, deployment or launch. Phase 60 and Phase 216 completion remain separate open obligations.
